name: lexai-legal-platform
description: Understand any legal document in seconds. LexAI provides risk analysis, clause simplification, document comparison, smart Q&A, and action checklists — powered by the Groq API.

auth.note: Optional — core analysis features are available without sign-in

features.name: Risk Analysis
features.description: Scores overall document risk 0–100 and flags individual clauses as HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW with plain-English explanations and actionable recommendations.

features.name: Clause Simplifier
features.description: Translates legalese into plain English. Classifies clauses, extracts key dates and deadlines, and summarises rights and obligations.

features.name: Document Comparison
features.description: Side-by-side AI diff between two documents. Detects added, removed, and modified sections with a similarity score and per-change significance rating.

features.name: Smart Q&A
features.description: Ask any plain-English question about a loaded document. AI responds with clause references and a confidence score.

features.name: Action Checklist
features.description: Generates a prioritised action list (Immediate / Short-term / Long-term), pre-drafted lawyer questions, and red-flag warnings.

documentSupport.note: Raw file bytes are never transmitted to any server

security.apiKeyStorage: Vite environment variable (build-time injection, never committed)
security.promptInjectionMitigation: response_format: json_object enforced on every call
security.privacyModel: All document parsing is client-side; no file data leaves the browser

variables.name: VITE_GROQ_API_KEY
variables.description: Groq API key (obtain free from console.groq.com)

variables.name: VITE_GROQ_MODEL
variables.description: Model identifier passed to the Groq API

disclaimer: LexAI provides informational assistance only and is not a substitute for professional legal advice. Always consult a qualified attorney for decisions with legal consequences.
